Our favourite restaurant in Hoi An
Jun 2026 • Couples
What a wonderful restaurant. Off the beaten track so could easily be missed. 
We went along following a search on Tripadvisor for a decent restaurant in the area and we enjoyed it so much that we went back the next night…….and again on our final night in Hoi An. Three times in four days!
A wonderful warm welcome, great service and delicious food which was so fresh and tasty. 
Very reasonably priced and cannot praise it more highly. Wish we were there for dinner tonight!!
